title: Pipeline CRM
tagline: One place for a trade shop's leads, estimates, invoices, deposits and jobs.
stateNote: Used by one shop. There is no public demo, and I don't show its data.
problem: Invoice2Go handled invoices, but the shop still needed a single place for leads, estimates, deposits, job status and talking to the crew.
audience: Don Howard Construction / Painting: the people in the office and the crew in the field.
contribution: I built it as a Next.js progressive web app that works on phones and in the office.
worksToday: Leads, estimates and invoices live in one system instead of several apps.
Deposits and payments are recorded against the job.
Job status and history are kept without a second spreadsheet.
A simple crew channel keeps the field from being a black box.
limitations: It is one client's private system, so there is no public sign-up or demo.
I don't publish customer data or screenshots of it.

evidence.label: Production address, as listed on this site's earlier Work page

involve.headline: Running a trade shop on a pile of apps and spreadsheets?
asks: Tell me how money and labor move through your shop and I'll tell you honestly whether custom software is worth it.
Know a shop that would benefit from this kind of system? An introduction is welcome.
